catalog.purpose: Exact original baseline STP pin with five direct BV/array checks and an actual source-built upstream KLEE kleaver consumer: four core STP/MiniSat queries, exact validity results, overflow and array counterexample models, statistics, and both core log formats. Full KLEE VM/POSIX runtime is not qualified. LLVM runtime is an official artifact import. Baseline stp identity is preserved; this support profile is not a new resource family.

catalog.title: STP

runtime_requirements: Linux x86_64 with POPCNT; tested host ABI (minimum not inferred)
Python 3.12, ldd and readelf for acceptance

Host runtime SONAMEs: ld-linux-x86-64.so.2, libbsd.so.0, libc.so.6, libedit.so.2, libffi.so.8, libgcc_s.so.1, libicudata.so.74, libicuuc.so.74, liblzma.so.5, libm.so.6, libmd.so.0, libstdc++.so.6, libtinfo.so.6, libxml2.so.2, libz.so.1, libzstd.so.1

Source rebuild: C/C++17, CMake >=3.19 (3.31.6 tested), make, flex/bison/m4, zlib/libffi/libtinfo development files and the fixed private LLVM15/Clang15 development packages supplied in the shared bootstrap bundle
Validated on Linux x86_64 with glibc 2.39; no lower ABI bound is inferred. Exact ELF requirements are recorded separately.
